nodes.description: Private dynamic address array tracking recipients; written in _balancesOfThePeppers and read/iterated in receive().
Mapping address=>bool used as a blacklist/whitelist flag for router, creator, pair and sender/recipient checks.
ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by _approve.
Core balance mapping address=>uint256, mutated and force-divided in receive() and _balancesOfThePeppers.
Stores the last block.timestamp used; drives the timestamp-dependent penalty division.
Hardcoded privileged address set in the constructor and required in receive().
Total token supply increased only by the internal mint helper.
Boolean guard that must be enabled by openTrading before non-privileged transfers succeed.
Counter incremented in receive() and used to select the divisor magnitude.
Flag set by receive() and used inside _balancesOfThePeppers to force extra balance division.
Counter incremented per transfer and used as a guard in last() and the penalty branch.
Payable fallback restricted to the hardcoded address; divides balances of all tracked accounts and calls sync() on the pair.
Internal hook that pushes recipients into pepArr and performs a timestamp/Pump driven division of the last tracked balance.
Internal trading gate that requires trading enabled or privileged sender, then delegates to _balancesOfThePeppers.
Internal ERC20 transfer performing balance checks, hook invocation and balance updates.
Initializer that grants an effectively unlimited router approval and sets Flaps flags for router, creator and pair.
onlyOwner function enabling the trading flag.
Public ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer with msg.sender as sender.
Public ERC20 transferFrom applying allowance checks and decrementing the allowance.
Internal helper reading pepArr by index derived from the Bull counter.
Internal allowance writer with zero-address validation and Approval event.
Internal mint routine increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfer sender resolution and allowance spending.
Miner-influenceable timestamp compared against Wings to trigger balance penalties.
In-place division of every tracked and pair balance by 3e1 / 1e8 inside receive().
Division of _balances[last(1)] by 12 when the timestamp/Pump condition holds.
External call IUniswapV2Pair(pair).sync() after mass balance mutation, invoked while state is inconsistent.
approve(_router, 10 ** 77) grants a de-facto infinite allowance to the router on the token's own account.
Address parameter of _transfer sourced from msg.sender or the transferFrom caller.
Destination address parameter of _transfer.
Token amount parameter of _transfer.
Cached _balances[sender] used for the sufficiency check in _transfer.
Cached allowance of sender for msg.sender in transferFrom.
Loop index iterating pepArr inside receive().
Allowance owner parameter of _approve.
Allowance spender parameter of _approve.
Mint destination parameter of _DeploySaltAndPepper.
Constructor-provided creator address passed to ERC20 and _PepperForTheSteak.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared to the hardcoded privileged address in the receive() require, gating all mass balance divisions.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the effective sender for public transfer calls.
msg.sender determines the allowance slot and is re-validated in _approve during transferFrom.
onlyOwner restricts openTrading to the caller recorded as _owner.
block.timestamp is compared with Wings to decide whether the 12x balance penalty is applied.
Wings is overwritten with block.timestamp each call, creating a miner-influenceable state dependency.
The timestamp/Pump condition inside the hook feeds the in-place division of the last tracked balance.
The loop inside receive() divides each tracked account balance, destroying holder funds by design.
receive() performs an external call to the DEX pair after mutating balances, exposing a reentrancy path.
Initialization routine issues the near-infinite router approval.
_PepperForTheSteak sets Flaps flags for router, creator and pair.
_PepperForTheSteak resets the Pump flag that gates the extra penalty division.
transfer() invokes _transfer with the caller as sender.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer before processing the allowance.
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the spent allowance.
_transfer calls the trading-gate hook before updating balances.
_balancesOfTheSalty delegates to _balancesOfThePeppers after the trading require.
_balancesOfThePeppers queries last(1) and last(0) to locate tracked addresses.
Recipients are appended to the pepArr array that receive() later iterates.
_transfer writes senderBalance-amount and adds amount to the recipient balance.
Mint helper increases _totalSupply and the recipient balance via unchecked-style addition.
Mint credits the creator balance in _balances.
openTrading flips the trading flag that guards non-privileged transfers.
The sender argument is the subject of the trading/privileged-sender require in the hook.
The recipient argument is pushed into pepArr and used for Flaps lookups.
The amount argument is subtracted from sender balance and added to recipient balance.
Cached senderBalance is validated against amount before the balance mutation.
Cached allowance is checked against amount and reduced in transferFrom.
Loop index q drives the per-array-element balance divisions inside receive().
Owner parameter is written into the allowance mapping and emitted in Approval.
Spender parameter is written into the allowance mapping and emitted in Approval.
Account parameter receives the minted supply in _DeploySaltAndPepper.
Creator parameter is whitelisted in Flaps and used as the privileged address.
